name: Meetings
description: Archive speaker-attributed, time-coded meeting transcripts in a configurable Vault directory and migrate existing Hemory conversations without copying audio.

cli.summary: Migrate Hemory conversations into the configured meetings directory

args.name: source
args.help: Hemory root, user root, or conversation(s) directory (defaults to the first Vault under ~/.hemory/vault)

flags.help: Rescan and validate every discovered conversation
Plan the migration without writing to the vault
Hemory user id (required when more than one is found)
IANA timezone for historical timestamps without an offset

cli.summary: Incrementally sync new and changed Hemory meetings into the configured Vault

args.name: source
args.help: Hemory root, user root, or conversation(s) directory (defaults to the first Vault under ~/.hemory/vault)

flags.help: Preview incremental changes without writing to the vault
Hemory user id (required when more than one is found)
IANA timezone for historical timestamps without an offset

ja.name: 会議記録
